mapper.insert: insert into buy_request_comment(request_id, user_id, content, status, create_time) values (#{requestId}, #{userId}, #{content}, #{status}, now())
mapper.select: select c.id, c.request_id as requestId, c.user_id as userId, c.content, c.create_time as createTime, u.username, p.avatar from buy_request_comment c left join user u on u.id = c.user_id left join user_profile p on p.user_id = c.user_id where c.request_id = #{requestId} and c.status = 1 order by c.create_time asc
